story.headline: Danger Been So Long: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
story.subtitle: Mystikal · Cultural Moment · 2004
story.hook: Danger Been So Long is performed by Mystikal.
story.summary: Mystikal's "Danger Been So Long" reached #14 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Danger (Been So Long)" is the second single released by American rapper Mystikal from his fourth album, Let's Get Ready (2000), featuring American singer Nivea.
story.fullStory:
Mystikal's "Danger Been So Long" reached #14 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Danger (Been So Long)" is the second single released by American rapper Mystikal from his fourth album, Let's Get Ready (2000), featuring American singer Nivea.

The song peaked at #14 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Danger Been So Long was released in 2004.
